def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    total_unvisited = len(unvisited_nodes)
    proximity_weight = 0.8 - 0.2 * (total_unvisited / (total_unvisited + len(distance_matrix)))
    centrality_weight = 0.1 + 0.1 * (total_unvisited / (total_unvisited + len(distance_matrix)))
    lookahead_weight = 0.1 + 0.1 * (total_unvisited / (total_unvisited + len(distance_matrix)))

    def node_score(node):
        proximity = distance_matrix[current_node][node]
        centrality = sum(distance_matrix[node][n] for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node) / len(unvisited_nodes)
        lookahead = sum(1 for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node and distance_matrix[node][n] < proximity)
        return (proximity_weight * proximity) + (centrality_weight * centrality) + (lookahead_weight * lookahead)

    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=node_score)
    return next_node

import heapq

def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    priority_queue = []
    for node in unvisited_nodes:
        direct_distance = distance_matrix[current_node][node]
        if len(unvisited_nodes) > 1:
            sorted_distances = sorted(distance_matrix[node][n] for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node)
            regret_factor = sorted_distances[0] - sorted_distances[1] if len(sorted_distances) > 1 else 0
        else:
            regret_factor = 0
        weighted_score = 0.7 * direct_distance + 0.3 * regret_factor
        heapq.heappush(priority_queue, (weighted_score, node))
    _, next_node = heapq.heappop(priority_queue)
    return next_node

def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    closest_to_current = min(unvisited_nodes, key=lambda node: distance_matrix[current_node][node])
    closest_to_destination = min(unvisited_nodes, key=lambda node: distance_matrix[node][destination_node])
    candidate_nodes = [closest_to_current, closest_to_destination]
    next_node = min(candidate_nodes, key=lambda node: 0.7 * distance_matrix[current_node][node] + 0.2 * sum(distance_matrix[node][n] for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node) / len(unvisited_nodes) + 0.1 * sum(distance_matrix[node][n] for n in unvisited_nodes if n != node and distance_matrix[node][n] < distance_matrix[current_node][node]))
    return next_node
